description: Project Deep-Dive: System Architecture Defense & Failure Mode Analysis

prompts.statement: Defend the core architecture and concurrency trade-offs of an event-driven distributed pipeline. Walk through: (1) Ingestion flow and backpressure mechanisms, (2) Exactly-once versus at-least-once message delivery semantics with idempotent consumers, (3) Failure recovery and dead-letter queue (DLQ) processing when downstream workers fail or time out.
constraints: Defend architectural choices under 50,000 requests/second burst traffic
Specify deduplication strategy and state window retention
Demonstrate failure recovery without data loss or split-brain states

examples.input: Upstream producer retries identical message batch after network partition timeout
examples.expected: Deduplicated via unique idempotency key; downstream database executes single idempotent write without duplicate rows.

clarificationBranches.question: What is the primary database consistency model for the state store?
clarificationBranches.answer: Strong consistency for idempotency receipts and transactional account ledger balances; eventual consistency for read-heavy analytics aggregations.

followups.question: If a single tenant suddenly generates 80% of all events, how do you prevent consumer lag from stalling other tenants on the same partition?
followups.criterion: Explains composite partitioning (tenant_id + hash salt) or dynamic virtual queues with dedicated tenant rate limiters.

privateReference.approach: Structure answer with clear component boundaries: Ingestion Gateway -> Kafka/Event Log -> Consumer Pool with Outbox Pattern & Redis Deduplication Window -> PostgreSQL Transactional Commit -> Async DLQ on poison pills.
checks: Defines explicit idempotency receipt table schema with unique constraints
Identifies backpressure signals (consumer lag metrics, TCP window / HTTP 429)
Articulates split-brain prevention and atomic commits
privateReference.expectedComplexity: High system architecture depth with measurable trade-offs

packs.title: Project Architecture Defense: High-Throughput Pipelines
packs.instructions: Simulated live architecture deep-dive. Explain trade-offs, state management, failure scenarios, and production telemetry in depth.
